subject: LOWER-CASE function
notes: kb/Work PB64 T5 (2026-08-19) — LANDED; was DIVERGES: the CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION clause used to be swallowed by the OBJECT-COMPUTER attribute token sink (then, PB78, refused by name), so a program asking for a classification locale got the rule-4 invariant fold silently. The clause is a typed production now (characterClassificationClause; in either order with PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE, at most once — COBOL2104, counted by the ClauseCardinalities OBJECT-COMPUTER row since kb/Work PB3133), bound to a ClassificationSpec and resolved at activation, and LOWER-CASE without a phrase maps through the classification's LC_CTYPE: LOWER-CASE("I") → U+0131 under CLASSIFICATION IS TR (LO-I). Rule --check verified at 15.57.4 3).
